demo_caveats: Comparative Trends indices are relative search-interest signals, not market share.
The cross-brand chart uses only one comparative Trends request, not separate per-keyword normalisation.
Own-baseline momentum values are kept separate and must not be ranked against the comparative chart.
Use only sourced news items in the demo.
Do not use degraded deep-research narrative as client evidence.

national_trend_comparative_method.label: Search interest comparative index (12m)
national_trend_comparative_method.calculation: Average each brand in the single-request 12-month comparative Google Trends series, then scale the leading brand to 100.
national_trend_comparative_method.state_method: One FanDuel-anchored five-keyword DataForSEO Trends request per state; raw levels are not compared across states.
